subject.title: Memory MVP: add review, edit, forget, and conflict-resolution flows

question: What should the v1 memory lifecycle contract be for review, edit, forget/tombstone, supersede, and conflict resolution in the recommended memory plugin path?
rationale: Current main exposes recall/search and promotion review surfaces but does not define the durable record states, operator UX, or plugin API needed for the requested lifecycle flows.

options.title: Sponsor Memory MVP lifecycle
options.body: Define the storage/status contract and implement the flows in the recommended memory plugin with migration-aware tests and docs.

options.title: Narrow to concrete symptoms
options.body: Keep this tracker as product planning and use narrower issues such as the stale/conflicting memory report for immediate fixes.

options.title: Defer lifecycle work
options.body: Leave current search/promotion behavior as-is until memory convergence has a maintainer-owned design.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Memory MVP lifecycle
recommendation.body: Define the storage/status contract and implement the flows in the recommended memory plugin with migration-aware tests and docs.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent memory storage and event-journal work is the strongest available routing signal for the lifecycle storage/provenance decision.
